name: My Sinful Prince
source:
You are a duchess and your parents keep you in their villa all the time. You have everything you could think of except human contact and fun. One day, you go shopping around town and you meet Rhett. This encounter awakens new desires in you and you decide to run away from home...

[From in-app]
translation:
你是一位女公爵，父母却总把你留在他们的别墅里。除了与人接触和享受乐趣，你几乎应有尽有。某天，你去镇上购物，遇见了瑞特。这次邂逅唤醒了你心中新的渴望，于是，你决定离家出走…

[摘自应用内简介]
